name: @opera-incerta/desktop
description: Electron shell: native lifecycle, windows, dialogs, filesystem, and packaging.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/main.cjs && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload.cjs && esbuild src/smoke/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/smoke.cjs && node tools/write-build-identity.mjs
